name: Chathurya Sandabarana
description: Chathurya Sandabarana is a Sri Lankan singer from Tangalle. The Voice Sri Lanka Live Shows, The Voice Global Best of the Week, and concerts across Sri Lanka and in Dubai.
formats: Concerts in Sri Lanka and overseas
availability: Available for concerts, musical shows, school and community events across Sri Lanka and overseas.
lede: The Voice Sri Lanka, trained under Umaria Sinhawansa. Selected for The Voice Global "Best of the Week". Four Handawaka shows.
facts: The Voice Sri Lanka, Season 1: trained under Umaria Sinhawansa and reached the Live Shows
Selected for The Voice Global "Best of the Week", representing Sri Lanka
Four Handawaka shows: Colombo, Kandy, Havelock grounds and Galle
Concerts across Sri Lanka and in Dubai since 2022
